name: SquidMulticall run() drains user approvals
summary: SquidMulticall.run() executes an arbitrary Default call supplied by the caller, so the attacker targeted the Binance-Peg ETH token and used the multicall's standing approvals to transferFrom 1 ETH out of a user.
